title: Fee Waivers on Kestrel Advantage Balloon Contracts — Desk Guidance
content:
**Status.** A fee on a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract can be waived only while the contract status is active, assigned for repossession, repossessed or deficiency, as the contract record shows.

**Once and whole.** A fee transaction may be waived only once; a fee waiver entry already linked to that fee transaction in the posting history settles it. Waivers are always of the whole fee transaction; partial waivers are not granted.

**Waiver reasons.**

| Reason | Applies to | Condition | Limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Courtesy for on-time history | A late charge only | The installments in a row without a late charge are at least the tier's required number, and the courtesy waivers in the 12 calendar months ending on today's date, inclusive, are below the tier's allowance | The tier's allowance; a tier whose allowance is 0 receives no courtesy waivers |
| Servicing error | Any fee the company's own records show was caused by a company error, such as a payment posted late by Kestrel or an autopay draft taken on the wrong date | The company error shown in the records | Not limited in number |
| Bank error on a returned payment | A returned-payment fee | The customer's bank has confirmed in writing that the return was the bank's own error | — |

Repossession, transport, storage and condition-report expenses and extension fees are never courtesy-waived.

**Counting installments in a row.** The installments in a row without a late charge are the installment due dates after the installment due date of the most recent late charge on the contract (or from the first payment date when there is none) up to today.

## Hypothetical cases

- A Tier 2 contract (courtesy allowance 1, 6 installments in a row required) shows 7 installments in a row and no courtesy waiver in the last 12 calendar months: a courtesy waiver of a late charge is within the rule.
- The same contract asks a courtesy waiver of an extension fee: not within the rule, because a courtesy waiver applies only to a late charge and extension fees are never courtesy-waived.
- A Tier 5 contract: no courtesy waiver, since the allowance is 0.
